blogs.title: Why Modern Businesses Need Custom Website & Mobile App Development
blogs.content:
In today's fast-paced digital ecosystem, off-the-shelf templates rarely capture the unique essence of a growing brand. Custom web and mobile app development allows organizations to engineer digital touchpoints tailored specifically to their client journeys, ensuring maximum conversion and retention.


1. Scalability and High Performance

Custom applications built with technologies like Next.js, Node.js, and Flutter can handle exponential user growth without breaking. Optimized code bases ensure sub-second page loads, boosting Google search rankings and Core Web Vitals.


2. Enhanced Data Security

Off-the-shelf plugins often expose websites to common vulnerabilities. Custom enterprise solutions feature bespoke authentication, encrypted databases, and strict API access controls.


3. Tailored User Experiences

By tailoring user journeys specifically for your audience, from intuitive navigation to custom checkout flows, businesses consistently report conversion increases above 35%.
blogs.author: Md. Sorower Jahan

blogs.title: Maximizing ROI with Targeted Digital Marketing and Pixel Tracking
blogs.content:
Digital marketing is no longer about blindly spending advertising budget across broad channels. In 2024, data-driven targeting via Facebook Pixel, Google Tag Manager, and Demand-Side Platforms (DSP) allows brands to trace every single dollar back to revenue.


Precise Audience Retargeting

Implementing proper tracking pixels allows you to retarget high-intent visitors who added products to their cart but left before completing the purchase. Dynamic ads remind them with special offers, reducing abandoned carts by over 40%.


Search Engine Optimization (SEO)

Organic search remains the highest ROI channel online. Combining high-quality content marketing with structured technical SEO ensures long-term domain authority and sustainable traffic growth.
blogs.author: Anowar Hossain

blogs.title: The Art of Visual Storytelling: Motion Graphics & Brand Identity
blogs.content:
In a world of short attention spans, static visuals alone are often ignored. Dynamic motion graphics, 3D modeling, and cohesive brand identities capture attention within the first 3 seconds, conveying complex ideas effortlessly.


Instant Brand Recognition

A memorable logo and consistent typography establish subconscious trust with potential clients. Brands with cohesive visual guidelines see up to 23% greater revenue growth.


Engaging Video Content

Video content on social platforms generates up to 1200% more shares than text and image content combined. Investing in custom animations and product explainers pays immediate dividends.
blogs.author: Sumiya Siddiqua

blogs.title: Architecting Ultra-Fast Web Applications with Next.js 14 and Server Components
blogs.content:
Next.js 14 has redefined modern frontend engineering with React Server Components, streaming SSR, and automated font optimization. By executing data fetches on the edge, initial page loads become nearly instantaneous.


Zero-Bundle-Size Server Components

Server components eliminate unnecessary client-side JavaScript, ensuring that even users on low-bandwidth mobile connections enjoy snappy interactions without layout shift.
blogs.author: MD. Ridoy Islam Nasim

blogs.title: How to Build a High-Converting B2B Lead Generation Funnel in 2024
blogs.content:
Converting enterprise visitors into qualified corporate inquiries requires trust signals, authoritative case studies, and streamlined contact touchpoints without unnecessary friction.


Social Proof and Credibility

Highlighting established enterprise clients, verified testimonials, and certifications reduces buyer hesitation by over 60%.
blogs.author: Md. Nahiduzzaman

blogs.title: 3D Animation in Modern UI: Enhancing Customer Engagement without Sacrificing Speed
blogs.content:
Integrating 3D elements and interactive motion graphics provides an unforgettable experience when optimized using modern WebGL and compressed WebP/AVIF formats.


Balancing Aesthetics and FPS

By leveraging CSS transforms, GPU acceleration, and lightweight glTF models, you can maintain a buttery 60 FPS while delivering stunning visuals.
blogs.author: Sumiya Siddiqua

blogs.title: Cross-Platform Mobile App Development: Flutter vs React Native in Enterprise
blogs.content:
Choosing between Flutter and React Native is a critical strategic decision. Both deliver native-grade performance while dramatically reducing time to market and development costs.


Code Reusability and Native Modules

Modern cross-platform frameworks achieve 95% single codebase coverage while retaining direct access to camera, biometrics, and push notifications.
blogs.author: Farhan Hassan Jabil

blogs.title: Search Engine Optimization for Single Page Applications: Common Pitfalls and Fixes
blogs.content:
SPAs that depend heavily on client-side JavaScript rendering often suffer from indexing delays and missed search crawl opportunities. Implementing SSR and pre-rendering solves this definitively.


Canonical Tags, OpenGraph and Meta tags

Dynamic metadata injection guarantees beautiful preview cards on WhatsApp, LinkedIn, and Facebook, increasing social click-through rates.

RestoMaster is built to deliver fast, mistake-free dining service for cafes, fine dining restaurants, fast-food outlets, and cloud kitchens. From table reservation to kitchen token generation and automated VAT billing, manage everything from any device.

Why Leading Restaurants Trust RestoMaster:

  • Interactive Floor Plan & Table Management: Real-time visual table occupancy, waiter order taking, and bill splitting.
  • Kitchen Display System (KDS) & KOT: Instant kitchen ticket printing or screen display directly on kitchen tablets.
  • Menu & Recipe Food Costing: Track raw ingredient usage (meat, oil, vegetables) with every food order to prevent wastage.
  • Online Delivery Aggregator Integration: Centralize dine-in, takeaway, and delivery orders into a unified dashboard.
  • Daily Shift & Cash Drawer Closeout: Detailed daily register settlement reports with cash, card, and mobile banking reconciliation.

jobs.title: Demo Job
jobs.description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a talented and passionate professional to join our fast-growing engineering team at okobiz. You will collaborate with cross-functional product teams to deliver transformative digital experiences for global clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and deliver performant software solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and fellow engineers.
  • Ensure high code craftsmanship, documentation, and automated testing.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 2+ years of production experience in modern software engineering.
  • Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript, React/Next.js, Node.js, and databases.
  • Passionate about clean architecture, problem-solving, and continuous learning.

What We Offer (Perks & Culture)

  • Competitive compensation package with transparent performance reviews.
  • 2 Festival Bonuses per year (Eid-ul-Fitr & Eid-ul-Adha).
  • Subsidized nutritious daily lunch, unlimited artisan coffee, and team gaming lounge.
  • Modern high-spec engineering workstations at our Mirpur hub.

jobs.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Next.js & Node.js)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect, build, and scale high-performance web applications and enterprise SaaS solutions. You will collaborate closely with UI/UX designers and product managers to deliver seamless digital experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement robust, scalable frontend architectures with Next.js 14/15, React, and TypeScript.
  • Design and maintain microservices, RESTful APIs, and MongoDB schemas with optimal query performance.
  • Ensure high code quality, security, and automated testing across CI/CD pipelines.
  • Mentor mid-level and junior developers, conducting rigorous code reviews and architecture planning.

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • 3+ years of professional full-stack software development experience.
  • Deep expertise in React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Node.js.
  • Solid hands-on experience with MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and cloud deployments (AWS, Vercel, Docker).
  • Strong understanding of web security, API optimization, state management, and Git workflows.

What We Offer (Perks & Culture)

  • Competitive salary with bi-annual performance evaluations and increments.
  • 2 Festival Bonuses per year (Eid-ul-Fitr & Eid-ul-Adha).
  • Subsidized gourmet lunch, unlimited coffee, tea, and healthy snacks.
  • Flexible working hours with 2 days hybrid work per week.
  • Annual company pleasure retreat & recreation budget.

jobs.title: Frontend React / Next.js Developer
jobs.description: Join our frontend engineering guild to build pixel-perfect, lightning-fast user interfaces. You will translate sophisticated Figma prototypes into responsive, accessible web applications.
responsibilities: Build responsive, pixel-perfect frontend pages using React, Next.js, and Tailwind CSS.
Integrate RESTful and GraphQL backend endpoints with optimistic UI updates.
Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, FID/INP, CLS) and browser rendering speed.
Collaborate actively with UI/UX designers to implement interactive motion and micro-interactions.
requirements: Strong proficiency in JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, and HTML5/CSS3.
Hands-on experience with Tailwind CSS, Next.js App Router, and responsive design systems.
Familiarity with Git version control, component-driven development, and Figma-to-code translation.
Enthusiasm for writing clean, self-documenting code and learning modern web standards.
benefits: Annual performance bonuses and sponsorship for online technical courses.

jobs.title: UI/UX Product Designer
jobs.description: We are looking for a creative UI/UX Product Designer who loves shaping delightful user journeys and modern SaaS interfaces. You will be the creative champion of our products and client brands.
responsibilities: Design wireframes, user journeys, high-fidelity prototypes, and design systems in Figma.
Conduct usability research, competitive benchmarking, and customer empathy mapping.
Work hand-in-hand with frontend engineers to guarantee design integrity during development.
Contribute to brand collateral, presentation decks, and product showcases.
requirements: Demonstrated portfolio showcasing modern SaaS, mobile apps, or web platform designs.
Mastery of Figma (auto-layout, components, variables, tokens) and modern prototyping tools.
Deep appreciation for typography, visual hierarchy, micro-interactions, and accessibility.
Excellent communication skills to articulate design rationales clearly.
benefits: Top-tier hardware and Figma Organization license.
Flexible working hours and creative autonomy.
Weekly design critiques and professional growth budget.

jobs.title: Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer
jobs.description: Ensure the uncompromising stability, reliability, and security of okobiz systems. You will lead functional, regression, API, and automation testing for all our mission-critical SaaS products.
responsibilities: Develop test plans, comprehensive test matrices, and automated test suites (Cypress / Playwright).
Perform manual and automated API testing using Postman and Newman.
Identify, document, and track software defects with thorough root-cause reports.
Collaborate with developers during sprint planning to establish rigorous acceptance criteria.
requirements: 2+ years of hands-on experience in manual and automated software testing.
Strong understanding of SDLC, STLC, Agile/Scrum, and API testing methodologies.
Experience with Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium is a strong advantage.
Sharp attention to detail and analytical mindset.
benefits: Continuous training in test automation and security audit.
